title: Tokyo, Sunday Dec 20: Ikebukuro for Nicholas and family
lead: Two hours at a manga artist's desk, then the One Piece and Pokémon shops of Sunshine City, Animate and JUMP SHOP. Everything on foot, done by 18:30.
subject: Dec 20 tour: this works for us
meet_text: We meet at the school itself at 13:00: MANGA DOJO Tokyo, Sansho Building 602, 1-31-6 Higashi-Ikebukuro, Toshima-ku. It is 5 minutes on foot from the East Exit of Ikebukuro Station and 2 minutes from Animate. The afternoon ends at the station side at 18:30.
meet_hint: Ikebukuro is on the JR Yamanote line and three subway lines. From most of central Tokyo it is one train. Please arrive by 12:55; the class starts exactly on time.
meet_place: MANGA DOJO Tokyo 1-31-6 Higashi-Ikebukuro Toshima-ku Tokyo
footer: Reply to Yuuki if the plan works, or tell him what to change. Times are approximate and can move on the day.

workshop.h2: Two hours at a manga artist's desk
workshop.lead: MANGA DOJO Tokyo is a small manga school a few minutes from the station. The teachers are working manga artists, an interpreter sits in the room, and the school hands you the real tools: G-pens, ink, screen tone and manga manuscript paper. Nicholas leaves with his own character and a four panel comic.
facts: Working manga artists. The school's head instructor, Kazuo Maekawa, drew the Ace Attorney manga series.
G-pens, ink, screen tone and official manuscript paper are on the desk. Nothing to bring.
Beginners are welcome and the school takes children from age five. Adults draw at the same table.
workshop.quote_by: A guest from the U.S. who came with a 13 year old, in the reviews on the school's website
steps: Where manga comes from and how a page is made, from a working artist.
How to build a character from simple shapes, then shrink it into a chibi.
Storyboard a short story. Many guests draw something that happened on their trip.
Ink it and take it home
Pen the final page with a G-pen. The pages go home with you.
workshop.note: Both the 13:00 and the 15:15 classes are open on December 20. The school recommends 13:00 for families; 15:15 is its advanced class. Classes start exactly on time, so we arrive five minutes early.
